messages:
sarah: Heads-up — a customer (acme-inc) reports getting Access Denied when switching projects in Console after we rotated their API key. They can list org resources but project actions 403.

anita: Can you paste the exact error? 403 or 404?
sarah: 403 Forbidden from /v1/projects/{id}/actions in UI call. Console log shows call to /api/console/switch-project with token scopes = ["org:read"] — missing project:write. They said API key was rotated yesterday.

support-bot: Incident created INC-202632

james: Repro steps?
sarah: Steps I used:
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/123/actions"
Response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Body: {"error":"permission_denied","details":"missing scope: project:write"}
2) In dashboard, switch org -> project -> action blocked, same 403.

anita: Where did the token come from? rotated key should keep same scopes unless provisioning changed.
sarah: Token is a rotated API key from their admin. They used our "export key" flow. The header from the console call shows X-Api-Scope: "org:read project:write" initially, but after the project switch the gateway call only had X-Api-Scope: "org:read". Looks like the project id gets stripped and we lose scope.

james: That's interesting. Could be our session proxy normalizing scopes during route change. Can you grab gateway access logs (console-proxy) for the timeframe and include request headers and the upstream token id?
sarah: Pasted snippet:

[console-proxy] "GET /api/console/switch-project HTTP/1.1" 302 - req_headers: {"Authorization":"Bearer tok_abc123","X-Forwarded-For":"34.23.1.2","X-Api-Scope":"org:read"}

james: Hmm, notice it's 302 then final call to /v1/projects/123/actions with only org:read. Might be our client-side code doing a redirect and dropping the per-project scope header. Repro locally by toggling project switch in dev-console.

anita: Workaround: re-enter the API key in project settings or re-issue a new token with explicit project:write.
sarah: Customer tried re-adding key and it worked. They need a permanent fix.

eng-oncall: @james I'm taking this. It sounds like a header-mangling bug in console-proxy redirect path. I'll add a middleware patch to forward X-Api-Scope through 302s and add a regression test. Creating PR.

eng-oncall: Created issue RED-ENG-4521 and draft PR. Assigning to eng-proxy. ETA for patch: EOD.

sarah: Noted. Customer notified and will hold off rotation. :thumbsup:
